about.heading: About Me
about.intro: I'm Andrés Felipe Mulett Castillo, and I focus on automating processes and building software by combining solid engineering practices with the intensive use of AI coding assistants.
body: My work centers on spotting repetitive or manual tasks and turning them into reliable tools: automation scripts, data processors, desktop applications, and websites.

I use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as a core part of my workflow — not to replace engineering judgment, but to speed up implementation, explore solutions faster, and keep the code clean and well documented.
This site shows my real projects, built end to end with Claude Code and with their code open on GitHub: an online store, a restaurant system and an exam platform with responsible AI.

howIWork.heading: How I work with AI
howIWork.intro: I build software by directing AI agents. The agent writes the code; I define what to build, correct the business rules, set priorities and require proof that everything works.
howIWork.note: This site, the online store and the restaurant system were built this way. I present them as built with AI because that is exactly what I do: my contribution is judgment, method and verification.
howIWork.methodSubheading: Every project moves in short phases that end with evidence, not promises.
howIWork.rolesSubheading: AI speeds up the building. Judgment, decisions and accountability are still mine.
howIWork.decisionsSubheading: Real cases where I corrected the agent because the design didn't match how the business works.
howIWork.practicesSubheading: AI speed is only useful if the result is reliable.
howIWork.constraintsSubheading: Everything was built on a corporate Windows machine, without administrator rights and behind a proxy.
howIWork.ctaHeading: Want to apply this method to a process in your company?
howIWork.ctaDescription: Tell me what your team does by hand today and I'll propose how to turn it into a reliable tool, in phases and with tests.
